shared_elements: horizontal band of incised decoration encircling/spanning the surface
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic presence of a horizontal band of incised linear decoration set below the upper edge, which any tradition could produce independently. A shows nothing but a simple zigzag/chevron band on a plain vessel body, whereas B shows a fully figural scene: a large winged, bird-headed anthropomorphic figure in profile holding objects, flanked by columns of rosette-bearing plants and surmounted by dense rows of script — no shared motifs, relationships or rendering conventions.
